name: Amamiya Kana
source: Kana lives next door to the protagonist. She's messy, and has trouble with mathematics. She tends to take care of the protagonist and comes in through his bedroom window to cook for him. She makes curry very well. She gets along with everyone. She has no sexual knowledge.
